capacity_usable_kwh.notes: BMW Canada release: 66 kWh net within 70.2 kWh gross.
BMW US release: 67 kWh net usable (Canadian release says 66). Conflict between the two BMW releases; EV Database 67.1.

chemistry.notes: Estimated: auto-data.net lists Li-NMC for the 70.2 kWh eDrive35; BMW states NMC-811 for the larger i4 pack (same G26 generation, same Gen5 cell family). BMW pages for the eDrive35 do not state chemistry.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: auto-data.net lists 400 V for the eDrive35 pack (EV Database nominal 353 V, still 400 V class).

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: BMW US 2022 release describes navigation-triggered automatic battery pre-conditioning for the i4 eDrive40/M50 (83.9 kWh pack, a different pack). No page states it for the eDrive35; carried over as a software feature of the same G26 i4 and iDrive navigation, not a pack figure.

published_10_80_min.notes: 10-80% in 32 min (early testing; US and Canadian releases agree).
